entities.name: Zurgo
entities.description: A vicious orc of Tarkir, current Khan of the Mardu Horde, bound to the spirit dragon Neriv.

entities.name: Neriv
entities.description: Spirit dragon called into being by Zurgo.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: Former Mardu general who sacrificed his men when he ascended; Zurgo's target in the original timeline.

entities.name: Varuk
entities.description: Zurgo's former second who led the horde's desertion.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: Killed by Zurgo at the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon.

entities.name: Nexus of Fate
entities.description: Gateway through which Sarkhan fled into the past.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: Dragonlord whose brood Zurgo served; fell.

entities.name: Ojutai
entities.description: Dragonlord who agreed to cooperate with Zurgo.

entities.name: Stormnexus Ritual
entities.description: Ritual during which Zurgo called Neriv.

events.summary: In the original timeline Zurgo mobilizes the horde to hunt Sarkhan in Temur lands and suffers heavy losses.
events.quote: Zurgo mobilized the horde to hunt Sarkhan down

events.summary: The horde deserts Zurgo under Varuk.
events.quote: the rest of the horde deserted him afterward under the command of his former second, Varuk

events.summary: Zurgo kills Narset at the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon but Sarkhan escapes through the Nexus of Fate.
events.quote: He reached the Tomb of the Spirit Dragon and killed Narset

events.summary: In the current timeline Zurgo Bellstriker serves Kolaghan's brood, harassed by dragons.
events.quote: a subject to the brood of the dragonlord Kolaghan

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion Zurgo approaches Ojutai and they agree to cooperate, setting an example for others.
Zurgo unifies Kolaghan's warriors into an army that survives the attack.
events.quote: directed the disconnected Kolaghan warriors into a unified army

events.summary: After the fall of Kolaghan, Zurgo Stormrender leads the Mardu as khan.
events.quote: Zurgo Stormrender now leads the Mardu as khan

events.summary: In the Stormnexus Ritual Zurgo calls the spirit dragon Neriv into being.
events.quote: Zurgo called the spirit dragon Neriv into being

relations.quote: the current Khan of the Mardu Horde
he had a vendetta against Sarkhan Vol
the partnership of dragonlord and despised outcast
bound to the spirit dragon Neriv
